description_en: Queries the current private network traffic diversion configuration, used traffic, bandwidth, and execution time of a specified VPC
description_zh: 查询指定 VPC 当前的私网引流配置、已用流量、带宽及执行时间
name: DescribePrivateTraction

CurrentTraffic.description_en: The current accumulated diverted traffic, in bytes
CurrentTraffic.description_zh: 当前累计引流流量，单位为字节

GwlbeVswInfoList.description_en: The list of vSwitch configurations used by the gateway load balancing endpoint. The list must contain one to two different active zones
GwlbeVswInfoList.description_zh: 网关负载均衡终端节点使用的交换机配置列表，必须包含 1～2 个不同可用区

items.description_en: The vSwitch configuration for a zone
items.description_zh: 一个可用区的交换机配置

CidrBlock.description_en: The vSwitch CIDR block. Required when creating a new vSwitch
CidrBlock.description_zh: 交换机网段。创建新交换机时必填

VswInstanceId.description_en: The vSwitch instance ID. Required when using an existing vSwitch
VswInstanceId.description_zh: 交换机实例 ID。使用已有交换机时必填

MaxBandwidth.description_en: The private network traffic diversion bandwidth, in Gbit/s. When creating or modifying the configuration, valid values are 10 to 50, and the value must be a multiple of 10
MaxBandwidth.description_zh: 私网引流带宽，单位为 Gbps。创建或修改配置时取值为 10～50，且必须为 10 的整数倍

MaxTraffic.description_en: The upper limit of private network traffic diversion, in GB. A value of -1 indicates no limit
MaxTraffic.description_zh: 私网引流流量上限，单位为 GB。-1 表示不限制

TimeConfig.description_en: The traffic diversion time configuration. Supports fixed start and end times, or periodic settings based on start time, end time, day of the week, and date. For example, 00:00 23:59 * * indicates execution all day every day. The day of the week and date cannot be specified at the same time
TimeConfig.description_zh: 引流时间配置。支持固定起止时间，或按开始时间、结束时间、星期和日期设置周期，例如 00:00 23:59 * * 表示每天全天执行。星期与日期不能同时限定

TractionEndTime.description_en: The time when the last traffic diversion stopped. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter may not be returned if traffic diversion is still in progress
TractionEndTime.description_zh: 最近一次停止引流的时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒；仍在引流时可能不返回

TractionStartTime.description_en: The time when the last traffic diversion started. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
TractionStartTime.description_zh: 最近一次开始引流的时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒
